cite.locator: seção 5.4 Central Nervous System Effects (Central Nervous System Adverse Reactions)
cite.quote: Ciprofloxacin, like other fluoroquinolones, is known to trigger seizures or lower the seizure threshold.

cite.locator: seção 5.12 Prolongation of the QT Interval
cite.quote: Some fluoroquinolones, including ciprofloxacin, have been associated with prolongation of the QT interval on the electrocardiogram and cases of arrhythmia.

cite.locator: seção 5.16 Potential Risks with Concomitant Use of Drugs Metabolized by Cytochrome P450 1A2 Enzymes
cite.quote: Ciprofloxacin is an inhibitor of the hepatic CY1A2 enzyme pathway. Co-administration of ciprofloxacin and other drugs primarily metabolized by CYP1A2 (for example, theophylline, methylxanthines, caffeine, tizanidine, ropinirole, clozapine, olanzapine and zolpidem), results in increased plasma concentrations of the co-administered drug
cite.note: A bula não usa "strong" nem "potent" para o ciprofloxacino. Seção 12.3: "systemic exposure of tizanidine (4 mg single dose) was significantly increased (C max 7-fold, AUC 10-fold) when the drug was given concomitantly with ciprofloxacin (500 mg twice a day for 3 days)". Seção 7: duloxetina "Five-fold increase in duloxetine exposure". Seção 4.2: tizanidina contraindicada.

review.notes: cyp1a2_strong_inhibitor apoia-se em evidência funcional da própria bula (AUC da tizanidina 10 vezes maior, contraindicação com tizanidina, "Avoid Use" com duloxetina), não na palavra "strong". O trecho citado reproduz o erro de digitação da fonte ("CY1A2"). A bula é do comprimido oral; os registros cobertos por anvisa_principles podem incluir apresentações não orais, das quais esta bula não trata.
